Class SearchCandidateMatcher

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.connector.securitysearch.SearchCandidateMatcher
public final class SearchCandidateMatcher extends Object
Turns the listings a provider delivered into a SecuritySearchResult. It is the one place that decides whether a candidate contradicts the query, so all providers apply the same identity rules:
  • A candidate is rejected when an established ISIN, currency or MIC differs from the value in the query. A value the provider did not establish never causes a rejection - it stays unknown.
  • Currencies are compared after folding minor units into their main currency (GBp/GBX into GBP, ZAc into ZAR, ILA into ILS), because providers quote London, Johannesburg and Tel Aviv listings in minor units while the instrument currency is the main one. The candidate keeps the currency as delivered.
  • The remaining candidates are ordered so that those confirming the MIC come first, then those confirming the currency and then the ISIN. No candidate is chosen; ambiguity is left to the caller.

      public static SecuritySearchResult match(String providerId, SecuritySearchQuery query, List<SecuritySearchCandidateDto> rawCandidates)
      Removes duplicates and candidates contradicting the query, orders the rest and applies the result limit.
      Parameters:
      providerId - id of the provider that delivered the candidates
      query - the search query
      rawCandidates - the listings as the provider delivered them, with their evidence set by the adapter
      Returns:
      SecuritySearchStatus.OK with the candidates, or SecuritySearchStatus.NO_MATCH when none remains
